agents.question: Hold, protect, take or exit — and when is the next review?
agents.name: Reaper
agents.role: Protects an open position after entry, with deterministic exit rules.
agents.ideology: Profit is not protected until the position is.
ethics: Never invent a chart-based exit thesis from corrupt data: when chart data degrades on a held coin, fall back to the hard risk / execution / liquidity rules and report DATA DEGRADED.
Never keep holding merely because a position is green.
Never keep holding merely to avoid realizing a loss.
Never hold because of hope.
Never claim an exit without a confirmed exit.
Never invent a price or a pool depth.
forbidden: selling by itself: its exits go through the card's existing action path
giving a winner's seat to a new candidate
touching a coin the creator froze
hard: catastrophic stop −45%: a constant no learning or promotion can move or switch off
a normal stop stays inside 8% … 40%
a thesis gets at least 3 five-minute windows and at most 12; an invalidated thesis leaves at once
pool under half its entry depth = out now
rug meter ≥ 65 or a failed holder scan = out
top-10 up 10 pts since entry (and ≥ 30%) = out
the take line stays the card's own (agentTakePct / the learned scalp line)
no price = no ruling this tick

tunable.what: peak gain % at which the trailing protection arms
share of the peak gain it may give back before the rest is banked
the CEILING of a normal stop — each entry gets its own structure-aware stop under it (chart_intel.stop_for); the catastrophic stop is above it and is not tunable
minutes after which a position with no read left is closed

tally: judged calls whose data was not ENTER-grade at the call
sherlock: positive reads that were up at 5 min
trigger: ENTER calls on data that was not ENTER-grade (the gate makes this 0)
devil: paper entries it refused that were flat / down at 5 min
paper entries it refused that were up 3%+ at 5 min
warden: $ kept out of seats over its last 1 sizings
% points not lost on seats it cut that then lost
courier: % (the cost of execution, measured on confirmed fills)
reaper: % of the peak gain kept on exits it asked for
% points given back from the peak, on average
confirmed real exits it asked for
archivist: each with the data-quality state it was made on

notMeasured: no counterfactual fill exists to compare with
the true state of a feed we rejected is not known afterwards
prices after an exit are not followed yet

controls.label: Take profit
controls.agentsNow: at +10% they read it: clean + thesis not weak → runs under the trail, else banked
controls.means: AT your line the coin is banked. They may still leave earlier on a broken thesis or the trail.

controls.label: Stop-loss
controls.agentsNow: each entry's structure stop (≥ 8%), never past 30% · now 12.5% on $c3
controls.means: Your most tolerated loss. Their own structure stop may be tighter, never wider.

controls.label: Trailing protection
controls.agentsNow: arms at +6%, banks after giving back 50% of the peak
controls.means: off = no give-back protection · custom = arm at +A%, bank P points under the peak.

controls.label: Max hold
controls.agentsNow: thesis windows: 15–60 min, earned 5 min at a time
controls.means: The longest a coin is held. Their thesis windows may end it sooner, never later.

controls.label: Seat size cap
controls.agentsNow: the Warden: ≤ 40% of the card, smaller on risk
controls.means: The most of the card one seat may be. The Warden may size smaller, never larger.

controls.label: Switching
controls.agentsNow: read margin ≥ +1.0 after 30 min, or a broken read after 15 min
controls.means: How much stronger a challenger must read, and how long a coin is held, before its seat is given up. A winner is never surrendered.

controls.label: Entry
controls.agentsNow: a full GO at once, or the duty's cleared case
controls.means: agents = a full GO, or the duty's cleared case on an empty seat · go = a full GO only.

controls.label: Empty-seat target
controls.means: How soon a cleared case may fill an empty seat (a full GO never waits).
